intro.text: A nation ahead of Dayside in technology, with firearms; its citizens tend to look on Daysiders as uncivilized.
The empire that dominates the whole of Darkside, ruled by Emperor Skathan. Dynastic is the first language of every Darksider.

description.text: Skathan deliberately slows the flow of knowledge and technology between the Dynasty's provinces to keep them under his control. He also tries to block trade and contact with Dayside, hiding how much traffic really passes between the continents.
